prompt:
Create a 3x1 sprite sheet for a modern 16-bit-style pixel-art RPG: one MONSTER in three battle poses.

Image 1 is a LAYOUT GUIDE: three cells on white. In each cell the light-grey box shows where the monster stands and how big it is, the grey line is the ground, and the arrow shows the facing: the monster faces RIGHT, toward the heroes. Draw the SAME monster once in every cell, filling its box. Never draw the grey box, line or arrow.

Image 2 is the HOUSE STYLE: an approved hero sprite sheet from this same game. Match its sprite-pixel size, black outlines, flat shading with 2-3 tones per colour and level of detail exactly, but do NOT copy the hero; it is a different character.

Image 3 is an APPROVED MONSTER sheet from this same game (a DIFFERENT monster, idle | attack | hurt): match its sprite-pixel size, rendering, shading, outline weight and level of detail, and how much the poses move. Do NOT copy that monster's body, colours or equipment.

Render as true pixel art: the monster about 96-120 pixels tall in sprite pixels, every sprite pixel a hard-edged square, no anti-aliasing, no gradients.

Monster: a four-legged hunter-killer war machine seen from the side, built like a stalking predator: a long low armoured body of dark gunmetal-grey plates (grey, not black) with bright steel edges, rust streaks and bolts, carried high on exactly four long segmented metal legs with clawed steel feet, all four feet flat on the ground, two legs at the front and two at the back; a long angular wedge-shaped head at the front with a horizontal row of three large glowing bright red sensor eyes; two long scythe-blade arms mounted at the shoulders, folded forward close beside the head with the blade tips pointing forward and down; exposed pistons and cables at the joints; the whole machine sits in the middle of its own cell with empty space on both sides; palette of gunmetal grey, dark grey, rust orange, bright cold steel highlights and bright red sensor light. Keep every detail identical in every cell. FACE: the wedge head with the row of three red sensor eyes, each a clear bright spot.

Cells:
- left cell: idle, a ready battle stance facing right.
- middle cell: attack, a scything strike toward the heroes: the body low and lunging forward on all four planted legs (no leap, no rearing up), both scythe arms swung forward and down in front of the head, their tips just above the ground in front of its front feet, the red eyes flaring; exactly four legs and two scythe arms, as in the idle cell; the whole machine well inside the middle cell, facing right.
- right cell: hurt, knocked back on all four legs, the body tilted back a little, the head jerked up a little, both scythe arms (two, as in the idle cell, both clearly visible) pulled back close along the top of the body, small sparks drawn on the joints themselves, the red eyes flickering; no taller than its idle height, recoiling away from the heroes (leaning left), still facing right.

MOVEMENT: the attack and hurt cells are dramatic ACTION frames, not static stances. Use a clear diagonal line of action through the body but keep all four legs on the ground and the body low (no leap, no rearing up): swing the two scythe arms toward the heroes with the joints bent, so the blade tips stay well inside its own cell. Draw only the parts named in the description, the same in every cell: no sparks in open air, steam, smear or motion lines. Each of the three silhouettes must be clearly different. BODY: in every cell, standing on four legs seen from the side, every paw on the ground line unless it is lifted to strike or rear. No mist, smoke or ground effects.

One monster per cell and nothing else: no props on the ground, no effects outside the monster, no text.
Background: solid flat magenta (#FF00FF) everywhere, no floor, no shadows, no borders.
Avoid: two creatures in one cell, different creatures in different cells, background scenery, floor tiles, shadows on the ground, magic effects outside the cell, text, frame, border, grid lines, blurry, soft shading, gradient, 3d render, a rider, a pilot, wheels, treads, a cannon, a dome head, bronze plates, teal, more than four legs, a human face, sparks in open air, violet, purple, a ground line, a floor, a shadow under the feet, a single scythe arm.
